newsitem.title: USA: Champion Parts in creditor agreement.
newsitem.headline: Champion Parts in creditor agreement.

text.p: Champion Parts Inc said Thursday it agreed with certain trade creditors to restructure approximately $3.4 million in past due obligations.

Under the terms of this agreement, Champion Parts made a cash distribution in the amount of 10 percent of the total restructured indebtedness, issued approximately $1.0 million in non-interest bearing promissory notes and issued other obligations entitling the trade creditors to a portion of the company's defined free cash flow in years 2005 to 2009 of up to an aggregate of approximately $1.5 million, it said.

The company said it also settled a deferred compensation agreement with a former chief executive officer of the company. Under that agreement, Champion Parts received $195,000 in cash and a release of the deferred compensation obligation in exchange for assignment of two policies insuring the unnamed former executive.

The company also said it is continuing discussions with other unsecured creditors to restructure the associated indebtedness under terms substantially the same as the settlement with the trade creditors.
Champion Parts also said it is in discussion with its bank group on an interim financing agreement.
Champion Parts remanufactures fuel systems and other vehicle components.
